usb_audio.purpose: record XPS-30 sound into a DAW through USB COMPUTER

ports.name: USB COMPUTER
ports.purpose: DAW synchronization and MIDI communication with a computer

routing_features: Local Switch can disconnect the controller section from the internal sound generator for DAW control.
Soft Through can retransmit MIDI received at MIDI IN from MIDI OUT.
Clock Source can be MIDI IN or USB COMPUTER when Sync Mode is SLAVE.
Version 2 Favorites can transmit bank select and program change when recalled.
Version 2 Phrase Pads can transmit individually configured MIDI note messages.

external_controllers.name: PEDAL HOLD
external_controllers.documented_use: hold pedal; Continuous Hold Pedal enables half-pedaling

external_controllers.name: PEDAL CONTROL
external_controllers.accepted_devices: Roland EV-5 expression pedal or DP-series pedal switch
external_controllers.warning: Use only the specified expression pedal type.

usb_memory.purpose: USB flash-drive audio playback, backup, restore, and update media
usb_memory.manual_requirement: format the USB flash drive on the XPS-30 where the documented procedure requires it

storage_and_maintenance.update_media: system updater file is copied to the root of a XPS-30-formatted USB flash drive

connection_rules.rule: MIDI IN, MIDI OUT, and USB MIDI carry performance/control data; route sound separately through OUTPUT, PHONES, or documented USB audio.
USB COMPUTER is for a computer connection. Do not plan a direct USB-device-to-USB-device cable between the XPS-30 and another controller.
For a mono PA or mixer input, connect only OUTPUT L/MONO; use both R and L/MONO for stereo.
If sustain behaves inversely, check Hold Pedal Polarity before changing cables or hardware.
